'''Entomancer''' is an {{2|Elites|Elite}} {{2|Monsters|Enemy}} found in {{2|Hive}}.

== Pattern ==
{{Intents Table/start|Entomancer}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Beeeees!
|Intent = Attack4
|Effect = Deals 3 damage (×7;{{Asc2|9|×8}}).
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Spear!
|Intent = Attack3
|Effect = Deals (18;{{Asc2|9|20}}) damage.
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Pheromone Spit
|Intent = Buff
|Effect = Gains 1 {{BD2|Personal Hive}} and 1 {{BD2|Strength}}. If {{BD2|Personal Hive}} is already at 3, gains 2 {{BD2|Strength}} instead.
|GivesToEnemy = Personal Hive, Strength
}}
{{Intents Table/end}}

The Entomancer repeats a fixed three-move cycle: {{Int2|Entomancer|Beeeees!}}, then {{Int2|Entomancer|Spear!}}, then {{Int2|Entomancer|Pheromone Spit}}, and back to the start.

== Notes ==

* '''Personal Hive''' triggers whever the '''Entomancer''' takes attack damage, rather than whenever an attack is played. This means that it will trigger multiple times against cards like {{C2|Sword Boomerang}} or {{C2|Ricochet}}.

== Useful Cards ==
* {{BD2|Thorns}} from cards like {{C2|Abrasive}} will damage the '''Entomancer''' 7 (or {{Asc2|9|8}}) times whenever it uses {{Int2|Entomancer|Beeeees!}}
* Indirect sources of damage from cards like {{C2|Snakebite}}, {{C2|Inferno}} or {{C2|No Escape}} can damage the '''Entomancer''' without adding {{C2|Dazed}} to your draw pile.
* Strong single-hit attacks like {{C2|Bludgeon}} or {{C2|Bury}} can deal a significant amount of damage while only triggering {{BD2|Personal Hive}}  once.
* {{BD2|Strength}} reduction from cards like {{C2|Malaise}} can greatly lower the damage from {{Int2|Entomancer|Beeeees!}}.
* Cards like {{C2|Feel No Pain}} or {{C2|Compact}} can turn the {{C2|Dazed}} cards into a benefit.
